description: Taiwan Cancer Registry code table for CLASSOFTREAT (治療分類（本院／他院）). 碼冊出處：Longform p.83-88 治療狀態分類 (#2.3.2). Generated from tcr_decoder; every code round-trips through decode/encode (tests/test_codebook_conformance.py).

concept.display: Died at the reporting hospital without receiving any treatment there (diagnosed here and died or discharged critically ill, or diagnosed elsewhere and transferred here before dying)
concept.definition: Died at the reporting hospital without receiving any treatment there (diagnosed here and died or discharged critically ill, or diagnosed elsewhere and transferred here before dying)

concept.display: The entire first course of therapy was given at the reporting hospital, with none at another hospital (includes a case whose only first-course therapy is one of the registry's defined "other treatments")

concept.display: No first-course therapy at the reporting hospital: the whole first course was given elsewhere, or the case came for a second opinion with no treatment here, or the main treatment plan was set by another hospital (e.g. maintenance therapy continued here, or a referred-out partial radiotherapy course)
